response: Speech lifted to 44px above the tag, glow narrowed, stroke 1.5; see media/text-v6-speech.png. Pill background filed as todo.
summary: Name tags and speech are bigger (18/22 px) and drawn over foliage with a dark glow, which is a real improvement. But the author's own final screenshot shows the speech bubble sitting on top of the speaker's name tag, which is a legibility regression, and the glow is a smudge rather than a pill. I could not take a live screenshot of my own.

findings.what: The speech text overlaps the speaker's own name tag. In text-v5-speech.png 'Sprout' is dim and half hidden under 'Hello, this is a bubble!'. The author left this open as a new todo. The todo asked for tags placed above the tallest part of the creature without covering anything.
findings.suggestion: Stack the speech above the tag by measuring the tag height (offset >= 16 + 18 + padding), or hide the speaker's tag while it is speaking.

findings.what: The glow halo gives a smeared, blurry edge rather than the requested dark rounded pill. Glow combined with strokewidth 2-2.5 makes the glyphs look fuzzy ('this is' has a ragged gap). Contrast over bright grass or sky is only moderate. The 'Sprout' tag looks gray, not cream, because the glow darkens it where it overlaps other geometry.
findings.evidence: media/text-v5-speech.png; the todo detail said 'dark rounded pill'
findings.suggestion: Draw a real background pill (poly or a scatter of rounded rect markers sized from text bounding boxes), or drop the stroke and keep only a tight glow, then check on both light and dark backgrounds.

findings.what: Evidence is thin. There are no screenshots of the final state under varied conditions (many creatures close together, tags at the far edge). The reported frame time (1.2 ms median) came from the author with no before/after comparison. Version v2 was left in media/ as an unlabelled failure. The game was repeatedly exiting with code 1 during the session.
findings.evidence: my julia process for live_screenshot failed to load NeverendingGame (package load error), so I judged from the author's media and the code only
findings.suggestion: Add a screenshot with a crowded scene plus a before/after frame-time measurement; look into the exit-code-1 restarts.

findings.what: Changes are in dev/NeverendingGame/src/scenery.jl only; sizes and glow constants are hard-coded inline in the Stage constructor.
findings.suggestion: Pull font size, offset, and glow into named constants so the next layout fix (todo for overlap) is a one-line change.
